purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official Jiangsu government service page is reachable and identifies Qidong Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning as the implementing authority for real-estate registration. It references cadastral materials and a web-map URL, but the fetched page exposes no public Qidong parcel viewer/API, schema, or safe anonymous geometry response. No parcel polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/procedure custodian evidenced: Qidong Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning. This is not evidence of an open parcel geometry service or citywide parcel coverage.
